notes.title: Idle Waters - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone!  [/p][p]It’s been a while since the last update. Thank you for your patience!![/p][p][/p][p]This update is mainly for players who are in the final stage of the game... the challenge of catching [b]every fish[/b], including [b]all of their variants[/b]. We know it can take ages to catch some fish, and many dedicated fishers have already completed this incredible goal! (I really appreciate all having fun with this game!! Thank you!)[/p][p]Now, you’ll have a bit more help thanks to [b]new lures[/b]! Finally, that mountain of coins you’ve been saving will have a purpose.[/p][p][/p][h2]The lures[/h2][p]Lures can be equipped and will cost coins each time you catch something. They are used to highly increase the chance of catching specifc fish. For example:[/p][p]If a level 6 fish in its silver variant don't want to show up, you can use lures to greatly increase its appearing chance. Specifically, you'll use the lure for Level 6 fish, and the Silver Lure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/ad5b01fa0ef08e0c116f1b6bf33b4a2af358fe89.png"][/img][/p][p]Btw, lures can also be used to boost your chances of finding specific items and treasures! (Yes, those level 2 silver coins won't be difficult to find anymore!)[/p][p][/p][p]You can buy the Lure Box from the shop at a [b]high cost[/b]. It is an end-game item after all.[/p][p][/p][h2]Boost to charms[/h2][p][b]Charms have been updated too![/b] Some of you mentioned that charms didn’t feel very useful, so we’ve reduced the negative effects on certain charms, like the Treasure Charm! We’ve also lowered the slot cost for some charms, making them easier to equip, and mix and match to find the ones more suitable for your needs.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update and have fun out there fishing! 🎣[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, everyone! I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]If you are enjoying the game, please consider buying the Supporter Pack.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769100/Idle_Waters__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.16
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]just a small update with some fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fix: Dimensional Charm wasn't working for all fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The Bottle Notes collection UI sometimes showed part of the search bar from other collections.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.15
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Another small update to fix issues related to achievements that some of you had reported:[/p][list][*][p]Fix: A true treasure hunter - This achievement wouldn’t complete if you got a treasure from the cat instead of fishing it. After starting the game, the achievement should now complete automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Trader - Sometimes this achievement wouldn’t complete even if you made a trade. Please enter the game and make a trade (3 fish for one item). If the achievement still doesn’t unlock, try saving and reopening the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]I hope some of you can finally reach 100% thanks to these fixes. Thank you for reporting them and providing detailed information![/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.14
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I had to make this update as soon as possible after noticing (thanks to your reports!!) a new bug in the journal introduced by the previous update. I apologize to anyone who encountered this issue.[/p][list][*][p]Fix: When buying information using karma in the journal, it was only retrieving the item name, and the "Buy Information" button wasn't being removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Every time you fished, the journal would refresh to the first entry, making it annoying to use when tracking a specific fish.[/p][/*][/list][p]Sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your patience![/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.13
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 
It’s been a while since the last update. Thank you for your patience!![/p][p][/p][p]One of the most requested features is finally here: a way to filter your collection to see which fish you have and which you don’t:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/c1afce4c78a264a9d5532a52fec637f43ccf134f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ll now find a button to open the filtering options. You can filter by:[/p][list][*][p]Caught or Uncaught[/p][/*][*][p]Map[/p][/*][*][p]Level[/p][/*][*][p]Daytime[/p][/*][*][p]Weather[/p][/*][*][p]Whether you already have the aquarium item[/p][/*][*][p]Variants[/p][/*][/list][p]There’s also a search bar, so you can quickly find a fish by typing part of its name.[/p][p]I hope this makes managing the endgame a lot easier![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/ab81f50990076c720803e4b6e0471f025b53da98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next, I'll be working on a small content update to make the endgame a little more easy and enjoyable. Please wait a little longer for this one.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, everyone! I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]If you are enjoying the game, please consider buying the Supporter Pack:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769100/Idle_Waters__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.12
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A small new update:[/p][list][*][p]We now have more toggles for the Sell Settings of each fish variant. For example, you can choose to sell only silver fish but not golden ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: When the Fish Journal was open on a specific fish, and you obtained a variant of that fish, the journal wouldn't update unless you manually refreshed it (by selecting another fish, closing and reopening it, etc.) Very helpful for keeping track of a specific variant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Rank achievements were only being unlocked if you had a specific rank (D, A, or SSS). For example, if you played the demo and got rank C, then played the full game, you wouldn't unlock D rank until you reached A or SSS. You were still getting the achievement, but not immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you, everyone, for all your great suggestions! I've tried to implement as many of them as possible, and as quickly as possible. [/p][p]However, a few suggestions are a bit more time-consuming. So, the next update will take a little longer... but I’m (finally) working on improving the Journal experience!!! You'll be able to complete your collections with better QoL features soon.[/p][p]Please be patient and wait just a bit longer :)[/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments!![/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.11
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A small new update:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Lock Decorations toggle for the aquariums, so you can’t accidentally move them while repositioning the aquarium.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button at the top of all aquariums to quickly move all items from every aquarium into the inventory with a single click.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The aquarium count that shows how many fish of the same species you have across all aquariums now counts correctly based on the base fish, not the individual variants.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Fish with very long names (especially in German) may have had their names overlap with fish  value in the inventory details.[/p][/*][/list][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.10
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A small new update:[/p][list][*][p]Modified the appearance of scroll bars.[/p][/*][*][p]Standardized the wording of variant fish texts in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Fishing values are now displayed in the stats list. (finally!!)[/p][/*][*][p]Charm ingredients can now be clicked to open the journal, just like quest items and other icons.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click the main area of a notification to close it, not just the main "ok" button.[/p][/*][*][p]Item details in the inventory now indicate if the item is inside an aquarium (similar as if it is a quest item), and the quantity is shown when hovering with the mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Trash items were being ignored by the "Craft Material" toggle in the Sell settings.[/p][/*][/list][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.9
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A small new update:[/p][list][*][p]You can now buy two more aquariums, for a total of 10![/p][/*][*][p]You can purchase additional inventory upgrades! Prices have also been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! It’s been a week since the game was released! Time flies!!
Thank you so much for all your support![/p][p][/p][p]Today I bring you a new update: more fixes and more QoL features![/p][list][*][p]Items in the inventory will now display whether they are part of a current quest or a crafting recipe.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/391e8fcca7268a93a4c4e69c3fdc56b207afd903.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can click on a quest item slot to quickly open the related Journal entry.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/83ecd81d4792082d749f53f97b809ee6f76c3fa6.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]When hovering your mouse over the timer of a fish in the aquarium, it will display the timer as always, but also show the item the fish will give you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: For quests that require multiple items (like the bridge), the game was incorrectly considering that one item was enough to unmark it as a quest item. As a result, it could be auto-sold even if the "quest items" toggle was turned off. This is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: If you opened the game with a quest partially completed, the items you had already delivered were still marked as undelivered quest items, preventing them from being sold.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This has been an amazing week! Thank you, everyone! There are still more improvements to come. Some will take me a little longer, so please wait just a bit more![/p][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.7
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]A new update is here![/p][list][*][p]Journal entries are now linked together. If you press the aquarium item of a fish, it will take you to that fish's journal entry. The same happens if you press a fish icon from an item entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, the area icons in the journal are now linked to the map. For example, if you press the lake icon, it will take you directly to the lake.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The fish details icon in the inventory for fish variants was displaying the original fish sprite instead of the variant version.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The new journal preview data for fish variants wasn't displaying the aquarium item when it was already unlocked.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I'll keep working on more QoL features![/p][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! It’s been almost a week since the game was released! 
Thank you so much for all your support! It's been a crazy (in a good way!) week!![/p][p][/p][p]We have a new small update![/p][list][*][p]Fix: Aquarium distortion on vertical monitors[/p][/*][*][p]You can now preview the journal details of a fish or item directly from its inventory details panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, you’ll see a button that takes you to the full entry in the journal.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002864/d489ce552fa554accc079c8c3a97ecefdbfeff09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I'll keep working on more improvements![/p][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.5
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A small new update is here! Thank you for reporting bugs![/p][list][*][p]Fix: Weak and Strong Charms previously worked only for fish. Now they can help you find other items and treasures as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The cat accepted legendary fish as food[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Some computers had trouble switching monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell bottle notes, and the Selling Settings include a toggle for this option.[/p][/*][/list][p]There are still many things to improve![/p][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.4
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A small new update is here! Thank you for all your suggestions![/p][list][*][p]Now you can no longer recycle maps, but you can sell instead![/p][/*][*][p]New toggle options for the Sell Settings:[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle: Sell maps[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle: Sell fish with unknown aquarium item[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle: Sell craft materials (used to create Charms)[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle: Auto-recycle trash (instead of selling it)[/p][/*][*][p]Also, trash can no longer be sold[/p][/*][/list][p]Bottle notes are next! Expect a new toggle for Bottle Notes in the next update![/p][p][/p][p]I'll keep working on even more improvements and bug fixes!!  [/p][p]I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]As always, thank you so much for all your support!!![/p][p][/p][p]I've made a small update with some requested improvements:[/p][list][*][p]You can now see the price of fish and items in your journal.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, In your journal, you can see the time it takes for a fish to give you an item in the aquarium.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: The word "using" in the Charms menu was not being translated in other languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Fixed a rendering issue with the bottle notes in the water in a couple of areas[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I'll be working on even more requested improvements and bug fixes!! 
I appreciate all your feedback, positive reviews and comments![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Thank you so much for playing the game, reporting bugs and giving feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]This small update improves the backup system. Some people had their save data corrupted for different reasons, which make the game unplayable. This update help to prevent this problem and to fix it by using a backup save data.[/p][p]If you encounter this problem, updating the game to this version should fix it.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll be working on more requested improvements and bug fixes![/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]

notes.title: V 1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Thank you so much for all your support on day 1![/p][p][/p][p]I made a small update with some requested improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Mute button to quickly mute all sounds in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Shop window can be drag around[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Merchant first achivement not completing sometimes if you transfered your save data from the demo[/p][/*][/list][p]I'll be working on more requested improvements and bug fixes![/p][p][/p][p]Happy Fishing!![/p]
